scenes.name: hero
scenes.alt: Animated. On the left, the headline All your AI coding sessions in one clickable roost. On the right, a terminal runs iroost open, reads local and SSH profiles, monitors 3 active agent sessions, checks GitHub for open pull requests, and raises an alert that session atlas needs an answer. A result card appears showing sessions online with their git branch, model, and status marks, noting that sessions run in tmux and survive disconnects.

scenes.name: before-after
scenes.alt: Animated before and after. Before: five cards show common terminal headaches: tabs scattered across local and SSH servers, an agent paused silently 30 minutes ago asking for input, work lost when a terminal window closed, jumping between browser PR pages and terminals, and zero visibility from a phone. A green wipe reveals After: iroost open connects every session in a split view, rings a chime when an agent asks a question, preserves work in tmux, displays open pull requests in the sidebar, and offers private Tailscale browser access.

data.title: Your terminal workspace
data.caption: Illustration of managing multiple AI sessions without and with iroost.

before.text: Ten terminal tabs scattered across local and SSH servers.
An agent paused to ask for permission 30 minutes ago.
Closed a window by accident and lost the running task.
Flipping between GitHub in a browser and terminal tabs.
Zero visibility into long-running jobs from your phone.

lines: alerting on pending approval: Do you want to run make test?

lines.text: Connected. Press enter to attach or w for tailnet browser.

after: Every session on every machine in one split view.
Chime and desktop notification when an agent asks a question.
Sessions run in tmux and stay alive through disconnects.
Open GitHub pull requests and review actions in the sidebar.
Browser access across your Tailscale network on phone or laptop.

scenes.name: how-it-works
scenes.alt: Animated diagram of four steps, left to right. 1, Add machines: iroost profile add for local folders or SSH hosts, saved in config. 2, Run agents: Claude Code, agy, opencode in persistent tmux sessions. 3, highlighted, View and switch: iroost open split layout, arrow keys preview live, Enter to type directly. 4, Stay alerted: tone and desktop alerts, asterisk on waiting rows, Tailscale browser via w. Below, a loop line notes that pressing w opens the roost on your phone over Tailscale.
